remedy: Return the picture to Genan Import for a refund.
tell: All units are recalled. They are framed artwork with electric lights and sound featuring moving background scenes like waterfalls, snow, nature, wolves, elephants, or dolphins in seven different sizes.

title: CPSC and CESSO, LLC Announce Recall of Tree Stand Components
hazard: If the "Tree Lounge" is subjected to significant impact from a heavy load, a tube on the leveler can crack. If the leveler is installed beneath the "Tree Lounge," the bolts attaching the leveler to t…
remedy: Consumers should return their levelers to the firm for a free repair.
tell: All Tree Lounge tree stand levelers are included in this recall.

product: Children's Board Books with Sound Maker
title: CPSC, DK Publishing Announce Recall of Children's Board Books with Sound Maker
hazard: The sound maker mounted inside a plastic covering on the last page of the books poses a choking hazard to young children if removed.
remedy: Consumers should take these books away from young children immediately and contact DK Publishing to receive a replacement book of equal val…
tell: All units are recalled. The books feature eight different titles with a raised sound button in the lower right corner and the DK logo in the lower left corner.

product: Metal Twin/Twin and Twin/Full Bunk Beds
title: CPSC, Coaster Co. of America Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
hazard: A gap between the step of the built-in ladder and the top bunk allows enough room for a child's body to slip through but will not allow for a child's head to pass through. This poses a serious strang…
remedy: Consumers should stop using the bunk beds immediately and call Coaster of America for a free repair kit.
tell: Check for model numbers 2008, 2056, 2256, or 2258 and a Coaster Company of America label on the bed frame of the top bunk.

title: CPSC, Baby Trend Announce Recall of Certain Baby Trend "Passport" Strollers
hazard: The fold joint can collapse unexpectedly, causing the baby to fall.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the stroller and contact Baby Trends, Inc. immediately. Baby Trend will ask the consumer to send a cut-out sect…
tell: All units are not recalled; check for model number 1514 and manufacturing dates between July 10, 2003, and November 26, 2003, printed on the lower frame behind the seat.

title: CPSC, E & B Giftware LLC Announce Recall of Universal Electric Outlet Adaptor Plugs
hazard: Multiple metal plugs can be extended from the product at one time. Consumers touching an exposed plug, while the adaptor is inserted into an electric outlet, can receive an electric shock.
remedy: Stop using the adaptor plugs immediately and call E & B Giftware LLC for a replacement item of comparable value or a refund.
tell: You can tell the recalled adaptor plugs by MODEL: 1804 written on the bottom of the adaptor plug.

title: CPSC, Shaw Industries Announce Recall of Flammable Carpet
hazard: Due to a manufacturing error that over-treated the carpet with a "soil-resist" application, the carpet could readily ignite, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries. The recalled carpet violates t…
remedy: Shaw Industries corrected the manufacturing error and will replace the recalled carpet with the same or comparable carpet.
tell: Check the style name, style number, and color name against the specific list of recalled styles and colors provided by the manufacturer.

title: CPSC, Casio Inc. Announce Recall of Piano Benches
hazard: The screws and bracket assemblies attaching the legs to the bench can weaken and detach, causing the bench seat to collapse during normal use.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the benches immediately and contact Casio for instructions on how to return the product for a full refund plus…
tell: You can identify the recalled benches by the model name Bench DK in dark wood or Bench LT in light wood, featuring a plush leather covering and a Made in China sticker.

product: Modular Test Leads used for Electrical Testing Multimeters
title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Electrical Testing Components
hazard: The leads, which are used to connect probes to handheld digital multimeters when testing for the presence and amount of voltage present in electrical circuitry, can result in incorrect multimeter rea…
remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled modular test leads immediately and contact Fluke for information on getting free replacement compo…
tell: The recalled leads are red and black with no permanent probes, feature the Fluke logo, and lack the SureGrip symbol. Model numbers are on packaging or documents, not the leads.

title: CPSC, L&N Sales and Marketing Announce Recall of Cordless Sweepers Sold on QVC
hazard: The sweeper can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the sweeper immediately. A replacement sweeper will be offered free of charge by L&N through QVC. Consumers wil…
tell: All units have clear blue plastic housing and model number EB005 / 52008 written on a silver-colored label on the bottom.

product: LP and Convertible Gas Water Heater Temperature Controls
title: CPSC, White-Rodgers Announce Recall of LP and Convertible Gas Water Heater Temperature Controls
hazard: The gas water heater controls can gradually open instead of snapping open to full flow, which can cause soot to build up on the water heater burner, presenting a fire hazard.
remedy: Contact White-Rodgers to arrange for a qualified service technician to replace the recalled control, free of charge.
tell: Check the white label with red lettering on the right side for the model number and the four-digit metal stamped date code 0240 to 0329 located below the label.

title: CPSC, Trojan Technologies Announce Recall of Residential Water Disinfection Systems
hazard: Some of the lamp pins used in these disinfection systems are improperly soldered, and can cause the units to overheat, posing a fire hazard.
remedy: Contact Trojan Technologies to arrange a free lamp repair or replacement.
tell: Check the Underwriters Laboratories label on the power supply for models D, D Plus, E, E Plus, F, F Plus, Pro 7, and 15.

product: Majestic Vermont Castings fireplace remote receivers
title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Fireplace Remote Receivers
hazard: The circuit board can overheat and catch fire, posing a burn and fire hazard.
remedy: The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available.
tell: You can tell by the words Majestic Vermont Castings on the front label and model number ERX15 B on the CSA approval sticker on the back.

product: Hamilton Beach Cappuccino Plus Espresso and Cappuccino Makers
title: CPSC, Hamilton Beach Announce Recall of Espresso/Cappuccino Makers
hazard: The steam tube inside the espresso/cappuccino maker can burst under pressure, presenting a risk of injury to consumers. This can occur if the frothing nozzle becomes clogged and the espresso button i…
remedy: Hamilton Beach will ship free replacement espresso/cappuccino makers to consumers.
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking model number 40714 printed on the bottom of the black plastic and stainless steel machine.

product: Ashley "Trails End," "Cottage Retreat," and "Stages" bunk beds
title: CPSC, Ashley Furniture Industries Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds

remedy: Stop using the recalled bunk beds and get a free repair kit from the retailer to cover and close the entrapment gaps. Consumers can install…
tell: Check the model number on product stickers located on the inside of the lower rail on the top bunk end panel or the inside of the lower panel on the bottom bunk.
